metadata.description: Internal Claude Code plugins for Fluree demos and tooling

plugins.name: fluree-companion
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to your Fluree AI (Solo) stack and work against it — discovery, human-approved device login, Space MCP registration, and playbooks that read the stack's own version-pinned docs. Includes /fluree-companion:connect.

plugins.name: fluree-dataset-generator
plugins.description: Generate validated JSON-LD datasets for Fluree semantic graph databases. Creates RDF data models and realistic instance data with cross-file reference integrity checks.

plugins.name: fluree-cli
plugins.description: Companion for driving the fluree CLI well — probe-first doctrine, safety rails, and Fluree AI (Solo) remote workflows. Defers all command reference to the binary's own embedded docs.
